relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: The mean CSI score at baseline was 36.0 (range, 9–75) and decreased significantly to 29.3 (range, 5–83) at 6 months (p < 0.001 vs. baseline).

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: The mean ASC-12 score, which reflects the degree of skin allodynia, also showed a significant reduction after 3 months

key_findings: In 86 migraine patients, galcanezumab reduced CSI and ASC-12 scores by 3 and 6 months, even in non-responders, suggesting a possible direct central effect.
